title: Ron Johnson sees the Milky Way from a distance

tellings.quote: They say, "Ron, where would you like to go?" Said, "I'd like to see the Milky Way from a distance."

plain: A man named Ron Johnson was once asked, "Ron, where would you like to go?" and answered that he would like to see the Milky Way from a distance, according to the researcher Grant Cameron, who repeats what Johnson told him. In the story the offer comes from "they", whom Cameron does not name here, and the point is that someone could take a person far enough away to look back on the whole galaxy.
